name: Brill has the Beginner's Book of Ascension and Deathguard Simmer
contract: On the live realm (stream UGryc1wOL_g, 2026-08-29) the Beginner's Book of Ascension 75118 stands in Brill at QuestSuperTrack node 8868, and Deathguard Simmer 1519 stands beside the farm wagon east of the Brill road.
Before the fix Brill had no book and Simmer stood about 900 yd north on the Deathknell road, so neither counts within 60 yd of its Brill post.
Both spawns rest on the CoA Brill ground.
